node.title: Re: Can't exec "command": No such file or directory error (updated!)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I don't know much about [man://zsh], but my best guess is that this might be [id://1205217]. You might try system('/bin/zsh','-c','command task list');, but be aware of the security implications of doing this with with anything other than a fixed string.

Update: What is task? Because if it's a binary then my advice here is wrong - see my reply [id://11149024|here].
